svg.title: Fiducial detail: size and distance from the panel edge
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale. A round copper dot 1 mm across sits in a 2 mm circular opening in the solder mask, leaving a 0.5 mm ring of bare board. The outer 3 mm of the panel edge is shaded as the zone that machine clamps cover. The center of the copper dot is 5 mm in from the panel edge, so the clamps cannot hide it.

g.text: Round or square, 1 mm across; no label needed
Outer ~3 mm of the panel edge
Drawn to scale. Panel edge on the left. Dimensions in mm.
